author: Emir2_81818
quote: GTA 6 looks disappointing so far. The game seems boring, overrated, and full of bugs. The graphics are impressive, but graphics alone cannot make a great game. The gameplay looks repetitive, the missions seem slow, and the whole experience feels unnecessarily heavy. Rockstar has delayed this game for years, but I am not sure it will be worth the wait. People expect a masterpiece, but GTA 6 might turn out to be one of the biggest disappointments in gaming history.
